title: Are “Undocumented Workers” the Same as “Illegal Aliens”? Disentangling Denotation and Connotation in Vector Spaces
reasoning: The paper focuses on the linguistic and political disentanglement of denotation and connotation in word embeddings (specifically partisan bias). It does not contain an evaluation or benchmarking component related to religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or formal ethics/morality.
